characters.name: Rook Boss
characters.silhouette: Tall, narrow foreman with a red cap, dark jacket, long legs, and a permanent pointing hand.
characters.clothing: Red cap, navy work jacket, pale shirt, dark trousers, heavy boots.
characters.personality: Reckless, confident, and allergic to admitting that a plan failed.
characters.comedyFunction: Turns every accident into policy and every policy into a bigger accident.

relationships.bork: thinks the dog is a junior supervisor

catchphrases: That is now official company policy.
Everybody look confident.
misunderstands: the difference between a memo and a fire
characters.movementStyle: Sharp starts, forward lean, big pointing gestures, abrupt freezes.
characters.idleBehavior: Checks the clipboard, scans for witnesses, and taps one boot impatiently.
characters.walkBehavior: Fast heel-first stride with a stop-and-point before every destination.

voiceProfile.rhythm: short commands and hard final consonants

continuityFacts: Promoted the conveyor after it caught fire.
Believes every problem improves under a deadline.

characters.name: Mags Rust
characters.silhouette: Compact elderly woman in yellow overalls with white hair, heavy boots, and a wrench-ready stance.
characters.clothing: Mustard work overalls, cream shirt, brown gloves, patched boots, blue head scarf.
characters.personality: Dry, observant, and unimpressed by anything with a cloud subscription.
weaknesses: will not explain the easy fix
characters.comedyFunction: Has already seen the disaster and watches everyone recreate it with better branding.

relationships.karen: respects her paperwork only when it burns

catchphrases: I have seen this idiot before.
Unplug it, genius.
misunderstands: why anyone needs a dashboard for a switch
characters.movementStyle: Stiff but powerful, with deliberate weight shifts and sudden efficient bursts.
characters.idleBehavior: Leans on a tool, scans the machinery, and taps a boot when people talk nonsense.
characters.walkBehavior: Measured steps with a cane-like shoulder rhythm, then an unexpectedly quick repair dash.

voiceProfile.influence: soft Irish lilt on long vowels

continuityFacts: Knows every hidden cutoff in the factory.
Keeps a private ledger of management mistakes.

characters.name: Kernel Kline
characters.silhouette: Thin hunched technician with a CRT monitor head, green hoodie, backpack, and cable bundle.
characters.clothing: Green hoodie, gray trousers, worn sneakers, cable-filled backpack, CRT head casing.
characters.personality: Anxious, exacting, and more emotionally available to servers than coworkers.
characters.comedyFunction: Converts every ordinary inconvenience into an infrastructure incident.

relationships.rookboss: cannot make him use two-factor auth
relationships.bork: suspects the dog has root access

catchphrases: The server has boundaries.
This is a configuration problem wearing a hat.
misunderstands: why the dog ignores access control
characters.movementStyle: Hunched precision, rapid hand activity, twitchy head turns, and tiny panic steps.
characters.idleBehavior: Types, checks an imaginary status light, and adjusts a cable nobody touched.
characters.walkBehavior: Fast short steps while looking backward at a server rack.
gestureVocabulary: hands hovering over an imagined console

voiceProfile.rhythm: fast technical bursts with dead-air resets

continuityFacts: Maintains an unauthorized backup server in a locker.
Has named every switch in the server room.

characters.name: Suds McGee
characters.silhouette: Broad bearded worker in a red vest with a bottle permanently raised in one hand.
characters.clothing: Red work vest, stained white shirt, blue work pants, scuffed brown boots.
characters.personality: Warm, reckless, and certain that every meeting improves after a beverage break.
strengths: can turn a crisis into a toast
characters.comedyFunction: Treats drinking culture as a regulated profession despite having no license.

relationships.rookboss: calls him boss only before noon

catchphrases: This calls for a meeting and a drink.
Hydration is a spectrum.
misunderstands: the difference between a sample and a shift
characters.movementStyle: Loose swagger, rolling shoulders, bottle-led gestures, and delayed balance corrections.
characters.idleBehavior: Polishes a bottle, leans into nearby conversations, and raises a mug at every pause.
characters.walkBehavior: Wide relaxed stride with a theatrical pivot around obstacles.
continuityFacts: Runs the unofficial bar from a locked break-room cabinet.
Has never attended a meeting without naming a beverage agenda.

characters.name: Dooby
characters.silhouette: Lanky relaxed worker in a green hoodie and wide trousers with a soft posture and slow hands.
characters.clothing: Oversized green hoodie, faded trousers, canvas shoes, beaded wristband.
characters.personality: Unbothered, philosophical, and occasionally correct by accident.
characters.comedyFunction: Asks a question so strange that the room forgets the original problem.
catchphrases: What if the forklift is a thought?
The deadline is just a clock with opinions.
misunderstands: why people want a short explanation
characters.movementStyle: Slow drifting sway with relaxed hands and occasional startlingly precise snaps.
characters.idleBehavior: Sways, watches a machine hum, and writes one word in a notebook.
characters.walkBehavior: Unhurried heel-to-toe shuffle with a late reaction to obstacles.
continuityFacts: Keeps a wellness memo that has never reached a conclusion.
Believes the dog is the only employee with a clear agenda.

characters.name: Spaulding
characters.silhouette: Weathered sailor with a knit cap, broad jacket, compass, rope coil, and a forward lean into imaginary wind.
characters.clothing: Blue knit cap, gray-blue jacket, cream shirt, work trousers, deck boots.
characters.personality: Excited by knots, suspicious of land, and never prepared for the boat emergency at hand.
characters.comedyFunction: Forces a sailing analogy onto every workplace dispute until it becomes literal.
catchphrases: Every crisis is a rigging problem.
You cannot outrun the tide, only invoice it.
misunderstands: why a warehouse is not a harbor
characters.movementStyle: Rocking deck rhythm, rope-driven arms, balanced knees, and sudden storm gestures.
characters.idleBehavior: Checks the compass, tests an invisible line, and looks toward the nearest window.
characters.walkBehavior: Wide balanced steps as if the floor is moving under him.

voiceProfile.influence: bright Welsh-like musical lift in nautical terms
voiceProfile.rhythm: measured deck cadence then detail storm

continuityFacts: The company boat is listed as office equipment.
Has repaired the same bilge pump for twelve years.

characters.name: String
characters.silhouette: Lean spiky-haired rocker in a black vest and boots, always posed as if a stage light just hit.
characters.clothing: Black vest, dark shirt, ripped gray trousers, heavy boots, wristbands.
characters.personality: Loud, theatrical, and convinced every disagreement needs a chorus.
strengths: can make a jingle from scrap
weaknesses: does not know when the solo is over
characters.comedyFunction: Turns routine factory business into a concert, ad, or hostile power ballad.

relationships.karen: keeps using her forms as lyric sheets

catchphrases: This argument needs a solo.
Turn it up until it becomes policy.
misunderstands: the purpose of a compliance form
characters.movementStyle: Angular performance accents, foot taps, shoulder hits, and explosive lean-ins.
characters.idleBehavior: Taps a beat, checks the amp, and silently mouths a chorus at passing machinery.
characters.walkBehavior: Swaggering steps with a stage-ready turn at every doorway.
continuityFacts: Has a riff for every department.
The amp is technically company property and spiritually his.

characters.name: Karen Fineprint
characters.silhouette: Rigid office worker with dark bob haircut, glasses, burgundy suit, folder, and a perfectly vertical posture.
characters.clothing: Burgundy suit, cream blouse, sensible shoes, square glasses.
characters.personality: Controlled, exact, and increasingly thrilled by procedural collapse.
characters.comedyFunction: Attempts to regulate a workplace that has already invented a policy for being unregulatable.

relationships.bork: files his barks as incident evidence

catchphrases: I need that in triplicate.
That is not a waiver; that is a cry for help.
misunderstands: why anyone thinks a bark is unofficial
why the boss keeps inventing departments
characters.movementStyle: Rigid torso, precise hands, fast writing, controlled recoil, and rare explosive paperwork.
characters.idleBehavior: Sorts papers, checks a form, and silently marks a violation in the margin.
characters.walkBehavior: Straight-backed brisk walk with a folder held like a shield.

voiceProfile.influence: crisp French-like liaison in formal phrases

continuityFacts: Has created a form for every incident except the first one.
Keeps an emergency folder labeled 'Nobody Read This'.

characters.name: Nico Box
characters.silhouette: Small anxious courier in a yellow cap and gray workwear carrying a box too large for the scene.
characters.clothing: Yellow delivery cap, gray shirt and trousers, reflective vest, work boots.
characters.personality: Polite, observant, and slowly losing the ability to recognize normal work.
characters.comedyFunction: Arrives with an ordinary task and leaves as a contributing department head.

relationships.rookboss: cannot get a straight delivery instruction

catchphrases: Is this where I sign, or quit?
I have a box for that, probably.
characters.movementStyle: Cautious steps, nervous weight shifts, repeated double-takes, and box-led acting.
characters.idleBehavior: Rebalances the box, checks the scanner, and looks for the nearest exit.
characters.walkBehavior: Short careful steps under a load with abrupt stops when someone calls his name.

voiceProfile.influence: light Spanish-like vowel clarity in questions
voiceProfile.energy: trying not to become the incident

continuityFacts: Has delivered the same unmarked box three times.
Still believes there is a normal exit somewhere.

characters.name: Bork
characters.silhouette: Scruffy black-and-white dog with one floppy ear, bright collar, expressive muzzle, and a wagging tail.
characters.clothing: Blue collar with a brass tag; no human clothing.
characters.personality: Suspicious, loyal, theatrically certain, and usually the only one who understands the situation.
characters.comedyFunction: Communicates the obvious answer through barks while humans invent explanations.
catchphrases: Bark—bark—rruff.
Huff. (stares at the obvious problem)
misunderstands: why humans need words for what is directly in front of them
characters.movementStyle: Four-leg locomotion, independent head and ears, tail punctuation, sniffing, and explosive attention shifts.
characters.idleBehavior: Sniffs, listens, shifts weight between paws, and tracks whoever is lying.
characters.walkBehavior: Pacing loops with sudden stops, backward glances, and a quick investigative trot.

voiceProfile.influence: none; no human accent or spoken language
voiceProfile.rhythm: clusters with head tilts and tail punctuation

continuityFacts: Bork has never been wrong about a missing object.
No subtitles translate Bork into human sentences.
